parsed.explanation: Derived from documented state-imposed universal exposures with no working remedy, plus national border risk. The division's 2023 statute bars trans people from restrooms/changing rooms in all state or locally owned or leased buildings — including airports, courthouses, parks and public universities — with criminal trespass on refusal to leave; the single documented arrest was dismissed on standing, so the law was never substantively tested and remains enforceable against any visitor. The national regime adds traveller-facing border exposure: passport sex-marker restrictions upheld, X markers discontinued, officers instructed to refuse cases with document discrepancies and to consider lifetime fraud ineligibility; allied governments issued advisories after detentions of foreign citizens. Custody (immigration and prison) shows documented denial of care, forced labour and sexual abuse. State anti-discrimination and hate-crime law omit gender identity; LGBTQ groups issued travel advisories. Killing rate (3.7/100k) is background-level, not a campaign, and there is no documented police sweep. Below the 0.35 tier-1-only anchors because of the border and detention layer; above 0.25 anchors, which feature active police coercion.
